en.headline: Police investigate Sai Kung burglary after watches and earrings worth HK$245,000 stolen
en.dek: A 62-year-old woman reported the theft from her flat on Tuesday night; the case has been classified as burglary with no arrests so far.
body: Police are investigating a burglary in Sai Kung after a 62-year-old woman reported that watches and earrings worth about HK$245,000 were stolen from her flat on Tuesday night.

Officers received a report from the woman, surnamed Chan, at 8.47pm that valuables were missing from a room in her unit on Pak Kong Au Road. Initial checks found two watches worth about HK$200,000 and a pair of earrings worth about HK$45,000 had been taken.

The watches were understood to include a Rolex and a Gerald Charles. The case has been classified as burglary and is being handled by the Wong Tai Sin police district crime investigation team. No arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 西貢住宅爆竊 失約24.5萬元手錶及耳環
zh.dek: 62歲姓陳女子周二晚報案指北港坳路單位有財物失竊，警方初步點算兩隻手錶及一對耳環共值約24.5萬元，案件列作爆竊，暫未有人被捕。
body: 西貢發生爆竊案。警方周二晚上8時47分接獲一名62歲姓陳女子報案，指其位於北港坳路單位內一個房間有財物不翼而飛。
人員到場調查，經初步點算，相信單位內有兩隻共值約20萬元的手錶及一對值約4.5萬元的耳環被盜。據了解，手錶為勞力士及Gerald Charles。
警方將案件列作爆竊，交由黃大仙警區刑事調查隊跟進，暫時未有人被捕。
